description:
Monitor APT package updates on Debian and Debian-based distributions.

Features:
• Available updates and optional critical-update notifications.
• New, local/obsolete, residual configuration and autoremovable packages.
• Manual and automatic update checks with hourly, daily or weekly intervals.
• Apply updates and Remove unused packages as separate menu actions.
• Built-in APT and APT-get presets using the default terminal.
• Nala presets using XFCE Terminal, graphical authentication and a press-any-key exit prompt.
• Nala upgrades confirm automatically without automatic autoremove; cleanup remains interactive.
• Custom update and cleanup commands, ignore list and last-check timestamp.

Maintained by vanastasis. GNOME Shell 51.
name: Debian APT Updates Indicator
